$comment: Loops and stings from the site: the 404 page's no-signal static (registry/lib/signal.ts, the page's shader on the CPU) and the page heads' entrance. Motion follows the site and the animation rules: the static's band rolls up the frame at a constant rate (one roll per loop, so the last frame meets the first), its flow swings and returns, its grain runs; nothing else moves. Stings are not loops: logo-reveal rolls half the band through on the ease-out curve while the lockup fades in; rise brings the tagline in line by line as .rise does (12px, 500ms, 50ms apart, ease-brand). --still writes the first frame alone for reduced motion.
